text: Simplified checkout integration via a single /sessions API call that returns payment data to the client
quote: Your server makes a single Checkout API request to the /sessions endpoint. Adyen sends payment data from our server to your client-side application.

text: Advanced integration flow using separate /paymentMethods, /payments, and /payments/details API calls for full control
quote: Your server makes three Checkout API requests: /paymentMethods, /payments, and /payments/details.

text: Webhooks notify you of status changes so you don't have to poll the API
quote: With webhooks, you can avoid having to continuously poll an API endpoint, waiting for a change in status for an asynchronous process, or for updates that your account holders make.

text: Idempotency-key header lets you safely retry requests without duplicate processing
quote: To submit a request for idempotent processing, send a request with the `idempotency-key:` in the header.

text: Official MCP server lets you interact with Adyen via natural language through an LLM client
quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.

text: Test full client and server integration, including various transaction types, in a test environment before going live
quote: Test the different types of transactions with Adyen that your integration handles using test credentials.

text: Failed payment/modification responses include resultCode, refusalReason, and refusalReasonCode to explain the issue
quote: When the payment or modification request is unsuccessful, the `resultCode`, `refusalReason`, and `refusalReasonCode` describe the issue.

text: Machine-learning fraud detection plus a rule builder to create, backtest, and label custom fraud rules
quote: Create, backtest, and label custom rules with a rule builder interface | Machine learning powered fraud detection using global transaction data

text: Instant payouts to cards with immediate result of the payout attempt
quote: Adyen supports paying out to cards instantly, and immediately returns the result of the payout attempt.

text: Dashboard gives a visual representation of balances, sales, and payouts
quote: Get a visual representation of your balances, sales, and payouts.

text: Onboard and verify sellers, service providers, or contractors before paying them out
quote: Onboard sellers, service providers, or contractors on to your platform, and let Adyen verify them before paying out.

text: Configure payout frequency per merchant account
quote: You can configure the payout frequency for each of your merchant accounts.

text: Local payouts avoid SWIFT fees and are faster when you have a local bank account in that currency
quote: Local payouts are faster and avoid SWIFT fees. You need a local bank account in a country that uses that specific currency as the legal tender.

text: Supports online payments across web, iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter platforms
quote: Support online payments for web, iOS, Android, React Native, or Flutter.

text: Customize the styling of the checkout UI
quote: Customize the styling of your checkout.

text: Customer Area dashboard manages account and transactions with an overview of all payment channels
quote: Manage your account and transactions from our Customer Area, which shows an overview of all your payment channels.

text: Present payment forms localized to the shopper's language
quote: Customize the styling of your checkout. Present your payment form in the local language of your shoppers with our localization support.

text: Process payments on behalf of platform users, splitting payments between parties, deducting costs, and holding funds until payout
quote: Process payments: accept payments on behalf of your users using Adyen's payment processing platform. You can split the payments between one or more users, deduct costs as needed, and hold funds until payout.

text: Configure multiple payout currencies per merchant account
quote: You can configure multiple payout currencies for each merchant account.

text: Pay-per-transaction pricing with no setup or monthly fees
quote: Pay per transaction, with no setup or monthly fees.

text: Offer shareable payment links
quote: Offer payment links.

text: Detect, monitor, and mitigate fraud using Adyen's Protect risk management system
quote: You can detect, monitor, and mitigate fraud using Protect, Adyen's risk management system.
